verdict.rationale: Stripe Radar is a fraud-detection and rules service, not an agent or AI host that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. The probe showing an official Stripe MCP server is the server role and does not make this client-side axis applicable. Nothing in the evidence shows Radar connecting to external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
